title: Lighter and quicker
changes: The game needs far less graphics memory: characters are loaded when they come near instead of all at once, so someone far off can appear a moment after you arrive.
Less to download before you can play: only your own hero is fetched at login.
The ground and grass take less memory too. Grass tufts can look very slightly softer.
The server spends less time on every monster that is awake, so busy fights stay responsive for longer.
